end.summary: Discussed how earthworm tunnels let air and water enter soil.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised how soil animals help plants: earthworm tunnels let air and water in, and soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil. They first mixed up earthworms with animals that spoil soil, then recognised that earthworms loosen soil and help plants. At home, ask Pihu to explain one way earthworms help a plant using the words “air,” “water,” or “rich soil.”
